ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 6 — Focused Visit (Care-plan review) — Jean-Jacques Rousseau

text.paragraph: Twelve-week review on aripiprazole; urethroplasty follow-up. [S]

Mr. Rousseau returns twelve weeks after starting aripiprazole 5 mg and about sixteen weeks after urethroplasty. He sleeps about six and a half hours most nights. He still believes some former friends speak against him, but he now spends under an hour a day on these thoughts rather than most of the day, opens his letters, and has written most mornings for a month. He has had fourteen CBT sessions and plans two more. He has had no restlessness, nausea, stiffness, or new urges, and has taken the tablet every morning. The four-week weight check was missed while he was away walking in the hills; his weight was taken at the sick visit for back strain five weeks ago, which has fully resolved. He passes urine freely and gets up once at night at most. He has had no thoughts of suicide or of harming anyone. [S]

text.paragraph: Vital signs recorded on 2026-07-14; see the Vital Signs section. [S]

tr.td: No tremor, rigidity, or involuntary movements; no akathisia
Perineal scar healed; right inguinal hernia small and reducible, unchanged

Warm and courteous; mood "steadier than for years"; persecutory beliefs present but held with less conviction, and he can consider other explanations; no hallucinations; no suicidal or violent ideation

Fixed beliefs that former friends and colleagues are plotting to ruin him, with poor sleep, present for years and worse over the past year; cause not yet established; psychiatric and medical assessment under way
S — Synthetic presenting concern at the index visit, superseded by the diagnosis at the psychiatry consultation; his documented beliefs of 1766 are echoed.

Weak urinary stream, straining, incomplete emptying (post-void residual 180 mL), and painful urination since childhood, treated for years by self-dilation with urethral sounds; cause not yet established; urethral imaging and endoscopy booked
S — Synthetic presenting concern at the index visit, superseded by the urethrogram and cystoscopy diagnosis; his documented lifelong retention and self-treatment with bougies are echoed.

Delusional disorder, persecutory type (DSM-5-TR), of about nine years' duration, with non-bizarre beliefs of a coordinated campaign against him; no hallucinations, disorganization, or mood episode; normal cognition; insomnia secondary to preoccupation; synthetic modern counterpart of his documented persecutory beliefs
S — Synthetic modern diagnosis. His beliefs and conduct are documented (D); calling them a paranoid delusion is a retrospective interpretation (R), made difficult by the real persecution he suffered.

Bulbar urethral stricture, 1.5 cm, dense and ring-like (lumen about 8 French), idiopathic and probably congenital in origin, with decades of self-dilation; bladder trabeculation without hydronephrosis; kidney function normal; synthetic modern counterpart of his documented lifelong urinary retention

S — Synthetic modern diagnosis. His lifelong retention is documented (D); its cause is disputed (R), and the autopsy found no urethral lesion (D), so this stricture is not presented as his historical diagnosis.
Right inguinal hernia, reducible and minimally symptomatic, likely aggravated by years of straining to pass urine
S — Synthetic finding on examination; it echoes the documented rupture of 1758, whose site the source does not state.
Acute low back strain after splitting firewood, without sciatica, red flags, or urinary retention (bladder scan 20 mL); resolved within three weeks
S — Synthetic common injury; the wood-splitting echoes a documented habit (CLM-0020), but no back injury is documented.

list.item:
Delusional disorder, persecutory type, on aripiprazole (F22). Good partial response to combined CBT for psychosis and aripiprazole: preoccupation and distress much reduced, sleep restored, and writing resumed; the beliefs persist with less conviction, which is a realistic outcome. PHQ-9 4. No side effects. Twelve-week metabolic check: weight 64.4 kg (up 1.2 kg, 1.9 percent), waist 93 cm, blood pressure 124/78, fasting glucose 94 mg/dL, hemoglobin A1c 5.5 percent, LDL cholesterol 126 mg/dL; no clinically important change. [S]
Continue aripiprazole 5 mg each morning for at least a year, then review with him.
Complete the last two CBT sessions, with a written relapse-prevention plan.
Weight every three months; glucose, A1c, lipids, waist, and blood pressure yearly; AIMS at six months.
Safety plan reviewed and unchanged; the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline confirmed.

Bulbar urethral stricture after urethroplasty (N35.812). Sustained result at about four months: maximum flow 20.8 mL/s, residual 30 mL, IPSS 5, quality of life 1; creatinine 0.99 mg/dL. [S]
Uroflowmetry and residual at six and twelve months with the urology team.

Acute low back strain (S39.012A). Resolved without imaging. [S]
Lift with bent knees and split wood in shorter spells.

Right inguinal hernia (K40.90). Unchanged and painless. [S]
Watchful waiting.
